surface: Existing Market Metro app, Policy Lab > Benchmarks > Research workspace v3
checks: Default benchmark view loads v3 recorded execution.
Mission selector switches actual brief, journal, models, pilots and cost.
SQL output includes the post-run join-fanout audit annotation.
Model detail shows mature rows, feature recipe and validation error.
Rival-sale pilot displays the recorded -5.97 USD estimate and -8.98 to -4.43 interval.
Replay advances from pilot to failed commitment, and pause stops advancement.
Rejected and recovered commitment attempts remain separate.
Final evaluation shows observe, zero outreach and continued ordinary purchases.
Models, measured value, architecture, v2 and v1 views remain reachable.
Leaving the research tab stops recorded playback.
No outer horizontal overflow at desktop or mobile sizes; timeline and wide tables scroll internally.
DM Sans is the computed benchmark font.
No broken figure images or captured browser warnings/errors.
Temporary viewport override reset after QA. Research workspace left open.
limitations: Browser QA verifies the display and controls, not semantic correctness of all model analysis.
Recorded playback does not launch a new research mission or payment.
